text:
Resources & Community

Badger R User Group (BRUG)
Badger Biodata works closely alongside BRUG to share resources and collaborate. One of the resposibilities of Badger Biodata is to participate in BRUG’s meetings and contributing to BRUG’s website.

title: Coding With Real Biology.
text:
Badger Biodata Initiative




Coding With Real Biology.

The Badger Biodata Mission
We serve to promote a space on campus for learning, creating, and innovating with  biological data programming . Our mission is to give each member the opportunity to produce real collaborative projects using industry tools and methods.


The Value We Bring
 Collaboration is the foundation of our organization. We work alongside labs, student organizations, and other local groups whom have real biological data. Our members work in development teams to produce projects with these datasets.



Connecting with Us

Collaborators
For labs, student clubs, and speakers, please reach out to our club email: badgerbiodata@gmail.com


For those interested in membership
We are excited to see you! Fill out our membership form: - Interested Membership Form Membership is processed with 2 weeks. Watch your inbox for updates.


Current members
Utilize our discord server, or contact a leader directory.

title: Member Projects
text:
CNN Model Analyzing non-coding DNA for Cancer
Using Supervised training for a CNN to analyze large DNA datasets, specifically the non-coding DNA sequences, to discover possible patterns that result in Melanomia cancer.
  
Author(s): Jayden Merrick





Madison Lakeshore Preserve Biodiversity Trends Map
Upcoming Project
Lakeshore preserve plant data, collect by a local organization, that is mapped to display possible future trends for the biodiversity of the area.
